resources.string: Relaying calls and texts to your phone
The root helper isn\'t running. Install Magisk, then the TosbiSim module in Magisk, and restart.
Missing %s. Reinstall the module and restart the phone.
Missing %s. Restart the phone so the module grants them.
Texts are relayed to your phone
Another app receives texts. Restart the phone so the module sets TosbiSim as the SMS app.
TosbiSim is never put to sleep
The phone may pause TosbiSim. Restart the phone so the module exempts it.
Turn Bluetooth on: your phone talks to this host over Bluetooth.
Pairing is open: open the TosbiSim app on your phone and add this host.
Not paired yet. Tap \"Open pairing\" below, then add this host in the TosbiSim app.
%s is paired but not in Bluetooth range right now
No SIM detected. Insert a SIM (and check it is seated well).
locked, enter its PIN in the TosbiSim app
blocked, enter its PUK in the TosbiSim app
locked by the network or carrier
Full voice: the call test passed on this phone
Ready for the call test: in the TosbiSim app open Host → Call audio and run it with a friend. Until it passes, calls have no audio.
Basic mode: calls ring, are answered and controlled from your phone, texts and hotspot work, but call audio is not relayed. This phone\'s audio path hasn\'t been measured yet.
On, screen allowed until the escape window ends
%1$s; charge limit %2$d%% (not supported on this phone)
Off. Turn it on in the TosbiSim app once setup is done: the screen then stays off. To get this screen back later, press Volume Up 3 times, then Volume Down 3 times.
Verified: the TosbiSim team measured call audio on this phone.
Expected to work: same platform as a verified phone. Call audio switches on after a short call test.
Experimental: researched but not measured yet. Texts, call control and hotspot should work; call audio needs the call test.
Not tested yet. Texts, call control and hotspot should work (Basic mode); call audio isn\'t available until this phone is measured.
Locked, but OEM unlocking is on: it can be unlocked (this erases the phone).
Locked. Turn on Settings → Developer options → OEM unlocking, then unlock the bootloader (this erases the phone).
This phone reports that its bootloader can\'t be unlocked.
Magisk is installed. Tap \"Check root\" and allow TosbiSim Host when Magisk asks.
Not rooted yet. Unlock the bootloader, then install Magisk.
Root was refused. In Magisk → Superuser, allow TosbiSim Host and try again.
This phone can\'t advertise over Bluetooth LE, so your iPhone can\'t connect to it.
Installed. Restart the phone to finish.
